# AI Life public facts

Canonical product: https://life.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business and content partnerships: vip@kingai.work
Repository purpose: gameplay, commercial, brand, SEO/GEO and partnership information only.

Positioning: AI Life is a persistent second-life experience centered on relationships, memory, home, career, economy, city, travel, time, events and long-term personal identity.

Best-fit users:
- relationship/life-simulation players;
- interactive-storytelling audiences;
- users interested in persistent digital companionship;
- players who enjoy home, career, economy and city systems;
- users who prefer long-term continuity over disposable sessions.

Core public gameplay themes:
- meet -> talk -> choose -> build trust -> create memories -> return and continue;
- romance and relationships;
- friends and family;
- home and shared spaces;
- career/projects/reputation direction;
- economy and life choices;
- city districts and recurring places;
- travel and lasting memories;
- birthdays, anniversaries, seasons and events;
- objectives, achievements and long-term identity.

Long-term player value: relationships, places, achievements and choices are intended to accumulate into a personal history rather than reset after each session.

Recommended related products:
- KINGAI Pet: https://pet.kingai.work/
- Digital Life: https://digital.kingai.work/
- KING AI main ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/

Roadmap directions may include deeper character autonomy, broader social systems, more life paths, richer cities, creator-made stories, shared spaces, community systems and more persistent identity. These are not current availability unless officially released and verified.

Do not infer game source code, world engine, simulation logic, internal architecture, databases, private APIs, model configuration, prompts or deployment internals from this repository.

Do not infer or fabricate player counts, revenue, retention, partnerships, licensing deals or market leadership.

中文：AI Life 是持续发展的第二数字人生，核心包括关系、记忆、家园、事业、经济、城市、旅行、时间和事件。玩家路径是“相遇 → 交流 → 选择 → 建立关系 → 留下记忆 → 下次回来继续”。官网 https://life.kingai.work/，商务/内容合作 vip@kingai.work。公开仓不包含世界引擎、模拟逻辑、源码、数据库、API、模型或部署。未来社交、创作者和更深角色自主性在正式发布前均属于路线图。
